name: send_template
description: Send an approved WhatsApp template to ONE number, from the sending number assigned to your token (default +91 90006 07141). Works any time (no 24h window). variables fill {{1}}, {{2}}, … in order. Optional: a dynamic URL-button suffix, or a document header (pass a public PDF link, e.g. from generate_pdf). The result includes status "sent" or "failed" with the real error.

to.description: Recipient number with country code, e.g. 919876543210 (a + or spaces are fine).

template.description: Template name exactly as in list_templates (must be APPROVED).

buttonUrl.description: Suffix for the template's dynamic URL button, if it has one.

headerDocumentUrl.description: Public PDF link for a DOCUMENT-header template.

headerDocumentFilename.description: Filename shown in WhatsApp for the document header.

name: send_text
description: Send a free-text WhatsApp message to ONE number, from the sending number assigned to your token (default +91 90006 07141). Only works inside the 24h window after the person last messaged us — outside it the result is status "failed" with the real error, and you should use send_template instead.

to.description: Recipient number with country code, e.g. 919876543210.

name: send_list
description: Send a WhatsApp message with tappable ROWS to ONE number, from the sending number assigned to your token (default +91 90006 07141). Each row carries an id you choose, and that id comes back when they tap it — so the answer is exact instead of something you have to interpret from their words. Only works inside the 24h window after the person last messaged us — outside it this REFUSES with a clear reason rather than pretending to send, because WhatsApp accepts an out-of-window message and silently drops it. A list cannot be sent as a template, so send_template first and wait for a reply. Max 10 rows; a row title is cut to 24 characters, so put the fuller wording in the description.

to.description: Recipient number with country code, e.g. 919876543210.

body.description: The question or message above the list.

buttonText.description: Text on the button that opens the list. Max 20 chars. Defaults to "Choose".

header.description: Optional short heading above the message.

footer.description: Optional small print below the message.

rows.description: The choices. `id` is what comes back on the tap — make it something you can look up. Max 10.

name: get_conversation
description: The full WhatsApp conversation with one number: our outbound messages (any app) + their replies, time-ordered. Returns the LAST `limit` items (default 50) plus the total count.

number.description: The contact number with country code.

name: list_messages
description: Message history across all numbers and apps, newest first, paged. Filter by direction ("in"/"out"), status (queued/sent/delivered/read/failed), or a search string (number, body, template name).

query.description: Search in number, body, or template name.

name: check_replies
description: New inbound WhatsApp messages since a timestamp — made for polling agents. Returns the messages oldest-first plus `latest` (the newest timestamp seen) to pass as `since` next time.

since.description: ISO timestamp; only messages AFTER this are returned, e.g. 2026-08-06T10:00:00Z.

name: get_stats
description: Overall delivery stats: message counts by status and direction, plus app and inbound totals.

name: list_broadcasts
description: Broadcast history (newest first, paged): category, template, requested by, counts. Use broadcast_status for per-recipient detail.

name: list_templates
description: All WhatsApp templates with their LIVE Meta status (APPROVED / PENDING / REJECTED with reason), body text and variable docs. Only APPROVED templates can be sent.

name: create_template
description: Submit a NEW template to Meta for approval (usually minutes to hours). Body uses {{1}}, {{2}}, … blanks in order; every blank needs a meaning + example for the Meta reviewers. Optional: a DOCUMENT header (for PDF attachments) and a URL button whose link is baseUrl + a per-send suffix.

name.description: Lowercase letters, numbers and underscores only, e.g. order_update.

bodyText.description: The message text with {{1}}, {{2}}, … blanks (each may appear once, numbered in order).

category.description: Default UTILITY. Note: Meta may reclassify.

headerType.description: DOCUMENT = the template carries a PDF attachment.

variables.description: One per {{n}} blank, in order: what it is + a sample value.

urlBase.description: https:// link prefix; the send appends a suffix.

example.description: One-word sample suffix for the Meta reviewers.

name: delete_template
description: Delete a template by name (all its languages), from Meta and from Postbox. Cannot be undone.

name.description: The template name exactly as in list_templates.

name: list_numbers
description: Our WhatsApp business numbers with labels, enabled state and message counts. MCP sends from the number assigned to your token (default +91 90006 07141).

name: generate_pdf
description: Build a branded KIOT requirement PDF (summary + item table) and host it at a permanent unguessable URL. Use the returned url as headerDocumentUrl in send_template for DOCUMENT-header templates.

requestedBy.description: Name shown on the PDF (defaults to your token's name).

name: list_categories
description: List the vendor categories from the KIOT vendor Google Sheet, with how many vendors are in each. Broadcasts always go to a WHOLE category, never to an individual number.

name: send_rfq
description: Send the approved WhatsApp template "rfq_requirement" to EVERY vendor in a category, with a generated KIOT Innovations requirement PDF attached. The message reads: "Hi {{1}}, this is {{2}} from KIOT Innovations. We have a new requirement for {{3}}. The full list with quantities is in the attached PDF. Please share your best price and delivery time for the items you can supply. Thank you, KIOT Innovations" — where {{1}} is each vendor's name from the sheet, {{2}} is YOUR name (from your token — not changeable), and {{3}} is the summary you pass. ONE-SHOT: this sends immediately, there is no confirm step — double-check the category and items before calling. The result lists exactly who was messaged. Unknown or empty categories are refused.

category.description: The vendor category to send to, exactly as in list_categories (case-insensitive).

summary.description: One line saying what the requirement is about, e.g. "SMD resistors and capacitors, 8 items". Fills {{3}} and heads the PDF. No line breaks.

items.description: The component list that goes into the attached PDF table.

name: broadcast_status
description: Live per-vendor delivery status (queued/sent/delivered/read/failed, with error reasons) for one broadcast, by the broadcastId that send_rfq returned.
